trigger: an on-call engineer follows the module docstring's escape-hatch option 1 (remove the 'server pg shard partition invariant' token from ci.yml's Linux flake-retry.py invocation line) expecting it to fully de-wire the checker from CI
summary: escape-hatch docstring overclaimed scope: removing the ci.yml Linux invocation token only de-wires the Linux leg -- ci.yml's Windows (line ~1403) and macOS (line ~1699) legs invoke flake-retry.py with no --suite/name filter at all and pass straight through to `meson test`, so the checker (built via the OS-unscoped `if build_server` gate) would keep running there regardless of that single edit; harmful operator guidance under production pressure
classification_rationale: doc contradicted actual ci.yml behavior on 2 of 3 platforms; independently re-verified against ci.yml and tests/meson.build directly, not taken on the reporting agent's word alone

trigger: the changelog fragment described closing a recurring CI defect (silent shard-metadata drift), not a behavior change to a live operator-visible surface
